biography: Franz Konrad, a name whispered with a mix of respect and trepidation in the Artenova Roxmil Racing paddock, hails from the mountainous Styria region of Austria. Born into a family of timber merchants, Franz's first taste of speed came not on the racetrack, but tearing through forest trails on a modified quad bike his father begrudgingly allowed him to tinker with. At 19, a local hill climb event changed everything. Scraping together funds, he entered an ancient, beat-up BMW and shocked everyone, including himself, with a blistering run that earned him a wildcard entry into a national touring car series. His aggressive, no-holds-barred style quickly made him a fan favorite, and Artenova Roxmil Racing snapped him up three years later. Now, at 33, Konrad is at his peak, battling for championships and leaving a trail of scorched rubber in his wake, though his reputation as a hothead sometimes precedes him, costing him valuable points and straining team relationships.
drivingStyle: Konrad's driving style is a pure reflection of his personality: aggressive and unforgiving. He attacks corners with a fearless commitment, often pushing the limits of grip and leaving little margin for error. He's known for late-braking maneuvers and daring overtakes, much to the dismay of his competitors. While his tire management can be erratic due to his relentless pace, he thrives under pressure, often delivering his best performances when the stakes are highest. His raw speed is undeniable, but his consistency remains a work in progress.
rivalries: Enzo Bellini: A clash of styles. Bellini is methodical and calculated, while Konrad is all instinct. Their contrasting approaches often lead to tense on-track battles and heated exchanges off it.

Anya Volkov: A rivalry built on mutual respect and fierce competition. Volkov, a seasoned veteran, represents the old guard, while Konrad embodies the brashness of the new generation. They are evenly matched, leading to exciting races.
Kenji Tanaka: Tanaka accuses Konrad of unsportsmanlike conduct, particularly after a controversial incident at the Suzuka hairpin where Konrad forced Tanaka wide, leading to a DNF.
quirks: Always wears the same worn-out leather driving gloves, a gift from his grandfather.
Listens to classical music – specifically, Mozart – before every race to calm his nerves, a stark contrast to his aggressive driving style.
Refuses to start a race if his helmet isn't perfectly aligned, claiming it throws off his focus.
famousQuote: Second place is just the first loser.
careerHighlight: Winning the 24 Hours of Nürburgring in 2020, a grueling race where he pushed his car and himself to the absolute limit, securing a dramatic victory in the final laps after a daring overtake.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the Austrian Grand Prix in 2021, a devastating blow in front of his home crowd that cost him valuable championship points.
